description: Election Commission - Mr. W. S. Fernando of the Arachchikathuwa Pradeshiya Sabha Vacated his Office of member of That Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This falls under electoral processes as it concerns the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically addressing the vacancy of an elected position.
